critical_code_review_comments: _walk_streak correctly handles 1-day grace window: anchor=today first, fallback to yesterday — matches spec.
_compute_streak persists best_days monotonically: only writes best_set_at when current>best, otherwise just refreshes current_days/last_active_date. Confirmed idempotent across 5 calls.

Public endpoint correctly redacts: current_days set to 0 when show_public_badge=false, and only the three public fields {current_days, best_days, show_public_badge} are returned — no leaks of status/last_active_date/next_milestone/is_demo_data verified in test.
next_milestone uses the Duolingo ladder (3,7,14,30,60,90,180,365) with None at >=365 — verified against current=5 → 7.

Streak demo seed is gated by marker `streak_demo_seed=true` on the streaks doc (per main agent's note) so subsequent boots don't re-seed. The 5 demo sessions persist across container restarts via demo_seed=true flag on each session row.

_badges_for_provider streak branch correctly compares last_active_date == today UTC iso and gates surface to current>=3 — matches spec; verified the 🔥 badge label='5 días seguidos' appears on demo provider.

STREAK_LOOKBACK_DAYS=60 is a reasonable cap for the activity-date aggregate (cheap O(60) walk), and any streak longer than 60 days would not be detectable — minor: consider widening to 400 if 365-day milestone is meant to be reachable from real activity. (Not blocking — demo seed only covers 5 days anyway.)
Frontend StreakWidget cleanly degrades to null when /streak returns 404 (.catch sets streak=null, then `if (!streak) return null;`) — non-provider sessions don't render a broken widget.
